FROM gc_user u LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file AS f ON ui.avatar_file_id=f.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access AS ua ON ua.user_id = u.id WHERE ua.id IN

SELECT student_ua.user_id as userId,student_ua.id as userAccessId, student_u.username as username,student_ui.last_name as lastName, student_ui.first_name as firstName,student_ui.avatar_file_id as avatarFileId, max(student_uae.log_in_time) as lastLogin,f.id as f_id,f.name as f_name,f.file_url as f_file_url,f.save_type as f_save_type, uap.id as permission_id,student_a.code as code,student_a.subject_json as permission,max(mess.update_time) as lastActivityTime from gc_access teacher_a LEFT JOIN gc_access p on p.id = teacher_a.admin_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access teacher_ua ON teacher_ua.access_id = teacher_a.id or teacher_ua.access_id = p.id left join gc_access student_a on student_a.admin_id=teacher_a.id left join gc_user_access student_ua on student_ua.access_id=student_a.id left join gc_user student_u on student_u.id=student_ua.user_id left join gc_user_info student_ui on student_ui.id=student_u.info_id left join gc_user_access_ext student_uae on student_uae.user_access_id=student_ua.id left join sys_file f on student_ui.avatar_file_id=f.id
left join gc_group g on g.id = #{userCommonInfo.groupId}
left join gc_user_access_permission uap on uap.user_access_id = student_ua.id LEFT JOIN (select DISTINCT id,master_id,target_user_id,user_id,max(update_time) as update_time from gc_master_message where master_id=#{userCommonInfo.masterId} and target_user_id=#{userCommonInfo.userId} group by user_id)mess on mess.user_id = student_ua.user_id
teacher_ua.access_id=#{userCommonInfo.accessId} and teacher_ua.master_id= #{userCommonInfo.masterId} and student_ua.user_id IS NOT NULL and student_a.role_type=1
and g.group_access_ids::jsonb @> to_jsonb(student_ua.id::integer)
and student_ua.user_id in
#{userIds}
and 1=2
and REPLACE(concat( student_ui.first_name, student_ui.last_name, student_u.username ),' ','') like concat('%',#{userCommonInfo.name},'%')
and mess.update_time > now() - '#{pageParam.lastDaysScope} days'::interval
group by student_uae.user_access_id
ORDER BY lastActivityTime ${pageParam.orderByString}
ORDER BY lastActivityTime DESC

SELECT student_ua.user_id AS userId,student_ua.id AS userAccessId,student_u.username AS username,student_ui.last_name AS lastName,student_ui.first_name AS firstName, student_ui.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId,f.id AS f_id,f.NAME AS f_name,f.file_url AS f_file_url,f.save_type AS f_save_type,uap.id AS permission_id, student_a.CODE AS CODE,student_a.subject_json AS permission from gc_access teacher_a LEFT JOIN gc_user_access teacher_ua ON teacher_ua.access_id = teacher_a.id LEFT JOIN gc_access student_a ON student_a.admin_id = teacher_a.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access student_ua ON student_ua.access_id = student_a.id LEFT JOIN gc_user student_u ON student_u.id = student_ua.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info student_ui ON student_ui.id = student_u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON student_ui.avatar_file_id = f.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission uap ON uap.user_access_id = student_ua.id where teacher_ua.user_id=#{userCommonInfo.userId} and teacher_ua.master_id= #{userCommonInfo.masterId} and student_ua.user_id IS NOT NULL
and student_ua.user_id in
#{userIds}
and 1=2

left join gc_group g on g.id = #{userCommonInfo.groupId}
LEFT JOIN (select DISTINCT id,master_id,target_user_id,user_id,max(update_time) as update_time from gc_master_message where master_id=#{userCommonInfo.masterId} and target_user_id=#{userCommonInfo.userId} group by user_id)mess on mess.user_id = student_ua.user_id where teacher_ua.access_id=#{userCommonInfo.accessId} and teacher_ua.master_id= #{userCommonInfo.masterId} and student_a.role_type=1
and g.group_access_ids::jsonb @> to_jsonb(student_ua.id::integer)
and student_ua.user_id in
#{userIds}
and 1=2
and mess.update_time > now() - '#{pageParam.lastDaysScope} days'::interval
and REPLACE(concat( student_ui.first_name, student_ui.last_name, student_u.username ),' ','') like concat('%',#{userCommonInfo.name},'%')
and student_ua.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY student_ua.user_id )a

select s0.id as "subjectId",count(DISTINCT p.user_id) as "subjectUsers" from gc_user u LEFT JOIN gc_user_video_play p on p.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN gc_video v on v.id = p.video_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s1 on s1.id = v.sub_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s0 on s0.id = s1.fid where 1=1
and s0.id in
#{subjectId}
and p.master_id=#{masterId} GROUP BY s0.id

SELECT uap.id as permissionId,count(v.id) as videoNum,u.user_id as userId FROM gc_user_access_permission uap left join gc_subject g1 ON JSON_CONTAINS(uap.sub_permission,CONVERT ( g1.id, CHAR ))= 1 left join gc_subject g2 on g2.fid=g1.id left join gc_video v on v.sub_id = g2.id left join gc_user_access u on u.id = uap.user_access_id
where uap.id in
#{list}
group by uap.id

select info.*,ua.id as userAccessId from gc_user_info info LEFT JOIN gc_user u on u.info_id=info.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua on ua.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN gc_access ac on ac.id = ua.access_id where ua.master_id=#{masterId} and ac.role_type=0 and ua.user_id!=#{userId}

select
,f.id as f_id,f.name as f_name,f.file_url as f_file_url,f.save_type as f_save_type
,max(ext.log_in_time) log_in_time,ac.group_name from "gc_user" u left join gc_user_info ui on u.info_id = ui.id left join gc_user_access uac on uac.user_id = u.id left join sys_file f on f.id = ui.avatar_file_id left join gc_user_access_ext ext on ext.user_access_id = uac.id left join gc_access ac on ac.id = uac.access_id where uac.access_id = #{params.accessId} and uac.master_id = #{params.masterId}
and concat(ui.last_name,first_name) like concat('%',#{params.name},'%')
GROUP BY uac.id, u.id, ui.id, f.id, ac.id
